1.title: The ITIL Value System and Governance
1.text: Welcome to Module eight: The eye til Value System and Governance. It covers the exam area The eye til Value System. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do five things. Know the five components of the eye til Value System and explain its purpose. Define governance and explain its enabling nature and activities. Define operating model. Explain how the organization's purpose and operating model are supported by the value chain activities and management practices. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: The eye til Value System (forty percent). Exam format: forty multiple-choice questions in sixty minutes; twenty-six correct answers (sixty-five percent) pass. Validated against: the official eye til Foundation (Version five) syllabus, version five point zero (February two thousand twenty-six).

1.title: The ITIL Value System
1.text: The eye til Value System. The eye til Value System (eye til V S) describes how all the components and activities of an organization work together to enable value creation from demand (opportunity) to value. Five components. one. Component: Guiding principles. Role: Recommendations that guide an organization in all circumstances. two. Component: Governance. Role: How the organization is directed and controlled. three. Component: Value chain. Role: The activities (the eight lifecycle activities) that turn demand into value. four. Component: Management practices. Role: Sets of organizational resources for doing work or reaching an objective. five. Component: Continual improvement. Role: Recurring improvement of everything, at all levels.

1.title: The ITIL Value System, continued
1.text: The eye til Value System. The figure shows this: The eye til Value System: opportunity and demand in, value out, five components in between.

1.title: The ITIL Value System, continued
1.text: The eye til Value System. Purpose: to ensure the organization continually co-creates value with all stakeholders through the use of products and services. eye til four named this the service value system (S V S). In Version five it is the eye til Value System. Exam tip: Five components: principles, governance, value chain, practices, improvement. Remember P-G-V-P-I. The four dimensions and pestle (political, economic, social, technological, legal and environmental) are not components of the Value System.

1.title: Governance
1.text: Governance. Governance is the means by which an organization is directed and controlled. Enabling nature. Governance does not block work; it enables the organization to achieve its objectives in the right way, by setting direction and boundaries. Activities. Evaluate the current and future position, direct by setting policies and plans, monitor performance and conformance. Governance applies at all levels and links the Value System to the organization's purpose. Exam tip: Evaluate, direct, monitor. Governance directs and controls; management runs the day-to-day work.

1.title: Operating model
1.text: Operating model. An operating model describes how an organization is set up and works to deliver value: its structure, processes, people, technology and partners. It turns strategy into action. The organization's purpose and operating model are supported by the value chain activities (the work that produces value) and the management practices (the resources and know-how used inside those activities). Exam tip: Governance directs and controls; management runs the work. An option that says governance replaces management, or only applies to the board, is wrong.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Which list names the five components of the eye til Value System? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Guiding principles, governance, value chain, management practices, continual improvement. Option B is the eye til four value chain, C the dimensions, D pestle.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. Which statement about governance is C O R R E C T? (one) Governance is how an organization is directed and controlled. (two) Governance is an enabling activity. (three) Governance only applies to the board and never to teams. (four) Governance replaces management. The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: one and two. Governance directs and controls, and it enables.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which three activities does governance include? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Evaluate, direct, monitor. Governance evaluates, directs and monitors.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Identify the missing word(s). The eye til blank describes how all the components and activities of an organization work together to enable value creation. The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Value System. That is the eye til Value System.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A company describes its structure, processes, people, technology and partners and how they deliver value. What is this? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: An operating model. That description is an operating model.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. In eye til four this concept was called the service value system. What is it called in Version five? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: The eye til Value System. The Version five name is the eye til Value System.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. Name the five components of the eye til Value System. Answer: Guiding principles, governance, value chain, management practices, continual improvement. Question two. What is the purpose of the eye til Value System? Answer: To ensure the organization continually co-creates value with its stakeholders. Question three. Define governance. Answer: The means by which an organization is directed and controlled.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Name the governance activities. Answer: Evaluate, direct and monitor. Question five. What is an operating model? Answer: How an organization is set up and works to deliver value. Question six. What did eye til four call the eye til Value System? Answer: The service value system.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. eye til V S components: guiding principles, governance, value chain, management practices, continual improvement. Purpose: continually co-create value. Governance: direct and control; evaluate, direct, monitor; enabling. Operating model: how the organization is set up to deliver value. Old wording: service value system.
